question: Which film featuring caste and police brutality themes was submitted as India’s Oscar entry but banned domestically by the Central Board of Film Certification?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santosh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Santosh** is a critically acclaimed Indian film that explores themes of **caste discrimination** and **police brutality**.
 
• The film was selected as India’s official entry for the **Academy Awards (Oscars)**, showcasing its international recognition.
 
• Despite its global acclaim, the film faced a **domestic ban** by the **Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC)** due to its sensitive portrayal of social issues.
 
• The film highlights the plight of marginalized communities and sheds light on systemic oppression, making it a powerful work of social commentary.
 
• The controversy surrounding the film’s ban drew widespread attention to the challenges faced by filmmakers in addressing politically and socially sensitive topics in India.
